compatibility.read: Readers reject unknown protocol or schema versions; compatibility changes require a new published version.
compatibility.write: Writers emit only the current schema and protocol versions.
compatibility.migration: Use migrate-protocol --to <version> --dry-run to plan an explicit supported migration. Legacy singleton artifacts are migrated with a receipt-backed task-migrate action.

commands.name: protocol-info
commands.description: Reports versioning, lifecycle, command, guide, and public error compatibility metadata for external harnesses.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initializes a target project directory with ForgeLoop discovery adapters, schemas, and templates.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnoses project health, discovers adapters, and optionally repairs missing template files.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Updates installed templates, discovery adapters, and canonical engineering guides to the latest version.

commands.name: activate
commands.description: Emits an active session marker recording sessionId and activationMarker.

commands.name: route
commands.description: Evaluates task characteristics and deterministically routes required engineering guides.

commands.name: preflight
commands.description: Evaluates pre-implementation contract, routing, and gates; synchronizes work state when READY.

commands.name: advance
commands.description: Transitions the canonical lifecycle work state to an allowed target phase.

commands.name: next
commands.description: Returns deterministic next-action guidance and command recommendations based on active state.

commands.name: continuity
commands.description: Reads and displays current cross-harness continuity handoff notes.

commands.name: record-continuity
commands.description: Persists cross-harness operational continuity handoff notes bound to current state fingerprints.

commands.name: reconcile-continuity
commands.description: Reconciles continuity handoff notes with active work state and checkout state.

commands.name: clear-continuity
commands.description: Removes continuity.json for the active task without affecting lifecycle work state.

commands.name: prepare-completion
commands.description: Initializes execution-receipt.json with empty requirement evidence slots for the active cycle.

commands.name: run-check
commands.description: Runs an exact command, records the execution provenance artifact, and binds observed check evidence.

commands.name: run-action
commands.description: Executes one policy-authorized durable action using exact argv and shell:false semantics.

commands.name: action-propose
commands.description: Proposes a caller-reported durable action without executing it.

commands.name: action-record
commands.description: Records a caller-reported or externally observed non-authority action transition.

commands.name: action-show
commands.description: Reads one canonical durable action artifact.

commands.name: action-reconcile
commands.description: Reconciles a COMMIT_UNKNOWN action from externally observed evidence without retrying it.

commands.name: action-verify
commands.description: Verifies a COMMITTED action against independent canonical evidence; caller claims can never verify.

commands.name: action-authorize
commands.description: Authorizes one PROPOSED durable action through the canonical capability-policy and approval service.

commands.name: metrics
commands.description: Projects trajectory, action, execution, timing, and known usage metrics without mutating state.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Evaluates the current trajectory against a validated project-local reference scenario.

commands.name: approval-request
commands.description: Creates a durable fingerprint-bound approval request.

commands.name: approval-resolve
commands.description: Resolves one durable approval exactly once.

commands.name: record-check
commands.description: Records structured verification evidence (command, manual review, or test output) against a requirement.

commands.name: record-terminal-result
commands.description: Records external terminal result evidence (PUBLICATION or PRODUCTION_READINESS) into receipt.

commands.name: record-diagnosis
commands.description: Records an append-only diagnosis event or structured diagnostic case in the lifecycle event ledger.

commands.name: record-intervention
commands.description: Records an append-only intervention bound to hypotheses; the described change is never executed by ForgeLoop.

commands.name: record-hypothesis-disposition
commands.description: Records an evidence-bound hypothesis disposition update in the lifecycle event ledger.

commands.name: history
commands.description: Shows chronological protocol history reconstructed from canonical ForgeLoop state.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Emits detailed structured task trace with provenance and artifact relationships.

commands.name: reflect
commands.description: Analyzes diagnostic and correction history deterministically for information gain, repeated failures, ineffective interventions, and oscillation.

commands.name: progress
commands.description: Evaluates task progress across verification cycles and detects stalls deterministically.

commands.name: record-decision-criterion
commands.description: Records an append-only decision settlement criterion bound to the active contract fingerprint.

commands.name: complete
commands.description: Evaluates verification receipt coverage, gates, and ledger integrity to authorize task completion.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Performs read-only evaluation of verification receipt coverage and gate satisfaction.

commands.name: report
commands.description: Emits a human-readable or structured JSON summary report of protocol state.

commands.name: policy
commands.description: Evaluates active task state against named enterprise policy packs.

commands.name: policy-discover
commands.description: Discovers repository policy facts and candidate rules deterministically.

commands.name: policy-status
commands.description: Evaluates repository and task state against effective policy rules and baseline.

commands.name: policy-diff
commands.description: Performs semantic diffing between policy versions to detect tightening or weakening.

commands.name: rule-verify
commands.description: Verifies policy rules against mutation fixtures to prove detector efficacy.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Manages brownfield policy baseline violations with monotonic downward ratcheting.

commands.name: profile-interview
commands.description: Optional interactive or dry-run interview to refine project profile facts.

commands.name: bundle
commands.description: Exports current task artifacts into a portable task bundle archive.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspects target repository health, dirty files, active branch, and artifact freshness.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Displays current lifecycle phase, active checks, blockers, and artifact freshness bindings.

commands.name: validate-state
commands.description: Validates schema adherence and internal consistency of work-state.json.

commands.name: clear-state
commands.description: Removes work-state.json for the active task only, preserving sibling contract, routing, and ledger files.

commands.name: reconcile-closure
commands.description: Refreshes the work-state checkpoint of an EXECUTING task whose objective is already satisfied in the current repository, after contract-bound executed evidence, so canonical completion can proceed.

commands.name: validate-receipt
commands.description: Validates schema conformance and cryptographic bounds of an execution receipt file.

commands.name: validate-protocol
commands.description: Validates end-to-end cryptographic freshness, fingerprint bindings, and ledger integrity.

commands.name: task-create
commands.description: Creates a new task descriptor and initializes its isolated task state namespace.

commands.name: task-list
commands.description: Lists all discovered task descriptors and their current lifecycle phases.

commands.name: task-show
commands.description: Shows details of a specific task descriptor and its scoped artifacts.

commands.name: task-lock-status
commands.description: Reports a task lock record and its lease-based stale-lock classification.

commands.name: task-scope
commands.description: Updates or inspects write claims for a task before execution.

commands.name: task-migrate
commands.description: Migrates a legacy 1.0 singleton task state layout into a task-namespaced layout.

commands.name: migrate-protocol
commands.description: Safely migrates explicitly supported protocol state; unknown target versions fail without rewriting artifacts.

commands.name: task-unlock
commands.description: Removes an orphaned task lock file to recover an interrupted task.

commands.name: task-recover
commands.description: Caller-acknowledged recovery of a STALE or ABANDONED task; records durable state and releases effective write claims.

commands.name: task-repair-legacy-recovery
commands.description: Migrates one recognized legacy OPERATOR_RECOVERY_RECORDED boundary event into the modern durable recovery representation (append-only; original event unchanged).

commands.name: task-resume
commands.description: Reacquires a recovered task's write claims under project serialization and restores ordinary mutation authority.

errors.meaning: The current capability policy allows the action without an approval artifact.
errors.safeResolution: Do not create an approval; authorize the action through the current policy path.

errors.meaning: Policy requires a current fingerprint-bound approval before this action may proceed.
errors.safeResolution: Request approval with forgeloop approval-request and resolve it via forgeloop approval-resolve, then rerun the action.

errors.meaning: Policy requires host-attested authority that was not supplied through a host trust boundary.
errors.safeResolution: Perform the action through a host integration that supplies trusted authority context; standalone CLI cannot mint it.

errors.meaning: Action authorization evidence is missing, incomplete, or was not produced by the canonical authorization service.
errors.safeResolution: Authorize the action through forgeloop run-action or a trusted embedding host; caller surfaces can never mint AUTHORIZED.

errors.meaning: Capability policy denies this capability.
errors.safeResolution: Obtain an operator policy change outside the task, or do not perform the action.

errors.meaning: Action capability is not part of the canonical capability vocabulary.
errors.safeResolution: Use a documented capability from forgeloop protocol-info; unknown capabilities fail closed.

errors.meaning: External commit state of a started action cannot be proven.
errors.safeResolution: Do not retry; reconcile the observed external state with forgeloop action-reconcile.

errors.meaning: Evidence supplied for verification or reconciliation is missing, malformed, or unbounded.
errors.safeResolution: Supply bounded evidence references appropriate to the action type; do not paste raw external output into the ledger.

errors.meaning: The idempotency key already binds to a different canonical action fingerprint in this task.
errors.safeResolution: Use a new idempotency key with a new actionId, or reuse the existing logical action unchanged; never relabel an executed effect.

errors.meaning: Side-effecting action class requires an idempotency key.
errors.safeResolution: Supply a stable --idempotency-key that identifies the logical external action.

errors.meaning: Durable action artifact or parameters are malformed or schema-invalid.
errors.safeResolution: Correct the action fields reported by the structured error, then retry through forgeloop action-propose or run-action.

errors.meaning: Referenced durable action ID does not exist for the task.
errors.safeResolution: List actions with forgeloop action-show or propose the action first.

errors.meaning: The current capability policy does not match the policy lock or task policy snapshot binding this task.
errors.safeResolution: Restore the policy epoch recorded at task activation or create a new valid lock and snapshot before side effects.

errors.meaning: A capability policy is present but no valid policy lock exists to bind authorization identity.
errors.safeResolution: Record a valid policy lock (forgeloop baseline or policy-discover --write) before authorizing durable actions.

errors.meaning: Settling COMMIT_UNKNOWN external state requires trusted host attestation that was not supplied out-of-band.
errors.safeResolution: Reconcile through a trusted embedding host boundary; actor-supplied observations may only record UNKNOWN.

errors.meaning: Settling reconciliation requires at least one bounded evidence reference binding the observation to the action.
errors.safeResolution: Supply bounded external-state evidence references alongside trusted authority before settling ambiguity.

errors.meaning: An action is COMMIT_UNKNOWN and blocks progress until explicitly reconciled.
errors.safeResolution: Observe the external system and run forgeloop action-reconcile --outcome COMMITTED|NOT_COMMITTED|UNKNOWN with evidence references.

errors.meaning: Requested durable action transition is not part of the canonical state machine.
errors.safeResolution: Inspect current action state with forgeloop action-show and use a legal transition; never edit action artifacts by hand.

errors.meaning: Verification evidence does not resolve to a canonical passed ForgeLoop artifact bound to this task and action.
errors.safeResolution: Supply a canonical execution or check reference produced by run-check for this task; arbitrary strings fail closed.

errors.meaning: The action cannot reach VERIFIED through this surface; canonical independent postcondition evidence is required.
errors.safeResolution: Run an independent verification check, then record it with forgeloop action-verify; exit code 0 alone is not verification.

errors.meaning: Approval is one-time resolvable and has already been approved or rejected.
errors.safeResolution: Request a new approval if another decision is required.

errors.meaning: Approval artifact is malformed or does not bind the required fingerprint tuple.
errors.safeResolution: Request a new approval with forgeloop approval-request; never hand-edit approval artifacts.

errors.meaning: Approval no longer matches the current action fingerprint, contract fingerprint, task revision, or capability.
errors.safeResolution: Request and resolve a fresh approval against the current action revision.

errors.meaning: Authority grant file is malformed or expired.
errors.safeResolution: Obtain a valid authority grant from host operator.

errors.meaning: Authority grant does not cover the requested package.
errors.safeResolution: Request updated authority scope.

errors.meaning: Authority file placed inside untrusted project tree.
errors.safeResolution: Place authority file in host-managed trusted location.

errors.meaning: Attempted unauthorized addition of new violations to brownfield baseline.
errors.safeResolution: Resolve new violations rather than expanding the baseline.

errors.meaning: Cannot re-record baseline during an active task with policy snapshot.
errors.safeResolution: Resolve new violations or use monotonic baseline --update.

errors.meaning: An enabled check has no effective scope or target files.
errors.safeResolution: Provide an applicable target scope, configure matching files, or mark the rule unsupported.

errors.meaning: Check structure or required parameters are invalid.
errors.safeResolution: Provide valid check ID, requirement, and parameters.

errors.meaning: A policy checker threw an unhandled exception while evaluating its mutation fixture.
errors.safeResolution: Repair the checker execution path and rerun rule verification.

errors.meaning: A blocking rule checker failed to detect an intentional mutation fixture.
errors.safeResolution: Fix checker logic to properly identify target violations.
